source.title: Glossary
source.description: Definitions for Claude Code terminology. Learn what agentic loop, compaction, CLAUDE.md, hooks, subagents, MCP, and other core concepts mean.

source.title: Best practices for Claude Code
source.description: Tips and patterns for getting the most out of Claude Code, from configuring your environment to scaling across parallel sessions.

source.title: Tools reference
source.description: Complete reference for the tools Claude Code can use, including permission requirements and per-tool behavior.

source.title: Configure permissions
source.description: Control what Claude Code can access and do with fine-grained permission rules, modes, and managed policies.

source.title: Choose a permission mode
source.description: Control whether Claude asks before acting. Explains each permission mode, which one a session starts in, what auto mode's classifier blocks, protected paths, and how `claude -p` handles prompts.

source.title: Extend Claude with skills
source.description: Create, manage, and share skills to extend Claude's capabilities in Claude Code. Includes custom commands and bundled skills.

source.title: Create plugins
source.description: Create custom plugins to extend Claude Code with skills, agents, hooks, and MCP servers.

source.title: Plugins reference
source.description: Complete technical reference for Claude Code plugin system, including schemas, CLI commands, and component specifications.

source.title: Run Claude Code programmatically
source.description: Use the Agent SDK to run Claude Code programmatically from the CLI, Python, or TypeScript.

source.title: Run agents in parallel
source.description: Compare the ways Claude Code can take on multiple tasks at once: subagents, agent view, agent teams, dynamic workflows, and projects.

source.title: Create custom subagents
source.description: Create and use specialized AI subagents in Claude Code for task-specific workflows and improved context management.

source.title: Manage multiple agents with agent view
source.description: Dispatch and manage many Claude Code sessions from one screen. Agent view shows what every session is doing and which ones need your input.

source.title: Orchestrate teams of Claude Code sessions
source.description: Coordinate multiple Claude Code instances working together as a team, with shared tasks, inter-agent messaging, and centralized management.

source.title: Message your other Claude Code sessions
source.description: Let Claude list and message your other Claude Code sessions on this machine, and reach your sessions on other machines or in the cloud.

source.title: Orchestrate subagents at scale with dynamic workflows
source.description: Dynamic workflows orchestrate many subagents from a script Claude writes and you can rerun. Use them for codebase audits, large migrations, and cross-checked research.

source.title: Run parallel sessions with worktrees
source.description: Isolate parallel Claude Code sessions in separate git worktrees so changes don't collide. Covers the `--worktree` flag, subagent isolation, `.worktreeinclude`, cleanup, and non-git VCS hooks.

source.title: How Claude remembers your project
source.description: Give Claude persistent instructions with CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md files, and let Claude accumulate learnings automatically with auto memory.

source.title: MCP for Claude Code — authoring reference (hand scoped)
source.description: Writing a public, unauthenticated streamable-HTTP MCP server for Claude Code: tool search, schema/output/timeout limits, `_meta`, connection lifecycle, resources, prompts, install paths.

source.title: Agent SDK overview
source.description: Build production AI agents with Claude Code as a library (Python/TypeScript only). Compares to CLI, Client SDK, Managed Agents; capabilities table; API-key auth rule, branding guidelines, commercial license.

source.title: Agent SDK reference - Python
source.description: Complete API reference for the Python Agent SDK, including all functions, types, and classes. Use for exact signatures, fields, and defaults.

source.title: Model configuration
source.description: Configure which model Claude Code uses, effort levels, extended context, and the auto-compact window

source.title: Hooks reference
source.description: Reference for Claude Code hook events, configuration schema, JSON input/output, exit codes, and async, HTTP and MCP hooks — live effort level, permission mode, tool_use_id
